# kubesense_dashboard (Data Source)

Reads a dashboard by id or exact name, including system dashboards.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# System dashboards are read-only; copy one into a dashboard of your own.
data "kubesense_dashboard" "aws_ec2" {
  name = "AWS EC2 overview"
}

resource "kubesense_dashboard_json" "my_ec2" {
  name           = "EC2 – team view"
  dashboard_json = data.kubesense_dashboard.aws_ec2.dashboard_json
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Dashboard id.
- `name` (String) Exact dashboard name.

### Read-Only

- `dashboard_json` (String) The dashboard preset as JSON.
- `description` (String) Dashboard description.
- `type` (String) "user" or "system".
